title: Clarify export refusal precedence for a dangling final-component destination link
outcome: Describe the export and retained-document writers' actual dangling destination-link behavior precisely without implying symmetric existence checks.
acceptance: Task-sync export documentation distinguishes a dangling final-component destination link: write_with follows it during try_exists and can reach publication I/O, while write_documents inspects the entry with symlink_metadata and refuses the link before parent lookup; ordinary destination-before-parent wording is qualified without claiming data loss or changed production behavior.
